notes: Promoted from nine per-function sources. The destructor was moved inline into include/daObjWlPolelift_c.h: written out of line mwccarm 2004/b56 emits the synthesized D0 ahead of the written D1 and adds a homeless D2, which is the reverse of the cartridge's 0x021111a0 (D1) / 0x021111e0 (D0) pair. Inline emits D1 then D0 and no D2, and moves the key function to the first non-inline virtual, InitResources -- which is why this TU now emits the class vtable and RTTI chain as compiler-only output.

func_ov026_02111234 and func_ov026_021112a4 keep their placeholder names. They are file-local helpers with no ROM-proven spelling; the delinked .c source for func_ov026_021112a4 was rewritten as C++ with an explicit extern "C" definition and a daObjWlPolelift_c* parameter so one TU can declare and define it once. The bodies still walk a char cursor because the fields they touch are still modelled as padding.

The factory's vptr store changed spelling from `*(void **)actor = &_ZTV17daObjWlPolelift_c;` to `*(int *)actor = (int)&_ZTV17daObjWlPolelift_c[2];`. The per-function shard referenced the ROM's data symbol, which config/arm9/overlays/ov026/symbols.txt records at the public address point 0x02113ae0. This TU emits its own vtable, whose _ZTV symbol addresses the vtable object eight bytes lower, so the source has to compute the same address point itself -- the measured eight-byte bias tools/objisolate.py and tools/reloc_audit.py both pin. The symbols.txt address is unchanged.

Static initializer folded: the PoleliftModelFile handle (file 0x6db) and its destructor-registration node make mwcc emit __sinit_d_a_obj_wl_polelift.cpp itself (0x40, raw-byte-identical to retail __sinit_ov026_02112b7c with the same instruction sequence, literal pool order and relocation sites); the handwritten shard is retired. @422 clashed with the fleet and is renamed (@422->@127).
